CEO COMMENTARY BNY delivered strong results in the third quarter. With broad-based growth across our platforms, we increased revenue by 12% year-over-year, delivering significant operating leverage and earnings per share growth of 24%. For the quarter, we generated a very solid pre-tax margin of 39% and a strong ROTCE of 29%. Our performance in the quarter once again highlights the resilience and durability of our business model against the backdrop of an overall constructive but uneven operating environment. Client demand continued to grow, underpinned by our ongoing work to unlock the value inherent in the combination of BNY’s businesses enabled by our platform operating and commercial models. Sales and pipelines remained very healthy across products, client segments and regions and we launched several solutions during the quarter that are meeting emerging needs in the market. Looking ahead, our teams around the world are energized by BNY’s momentum and excited about the opportunities in front of us to create value for our clients and shareholders. – Robin Vince , Chief Executive Officer

The presentation of the growth rates of investment management and performance fees on a constant currency basis permits investors to assess the significance of changes in foreign currency exchange rates. Growth rates on a constant currency basis were determined by applying the current period foreign currency exchange rates to the prior period revenue. We believe that this presentation, as a supplement to GAAP information, gives investors a clearer picture of the related revenue results without the variability caused by fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates.
